prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: one finished, highly readable Chinese cultivation-game spirit-plant ecology MANAGEMENT UI ideal mockup. Landscape 16:9, designed for a 1920x1080 desktop game. The deliverable is the complete screen, not a monitor mockup or an explanatory poster.

PRIMARY GOAL: A player can instantly compare the SELECTED GROUND'S ENVIRONMENT against the SELECTED SPIRIT PLANT'S REQUIREMENTS, understand exactly WHY THE PLANT IS NOT GROWING, and see a meaningful SUBSTRATE CONFIGURATION workbench. Directly-overhead ecological plot management, no walking character.

VISUAL DESIGN:
Elegant restrained Chinese game interface. Slim deep blue-green / ink-jade header and fine gray-green painted wood dividers; pale ivory matte paper information areas, fine subtle fiber texture, dark high-contrast Chinese text, calm sage for suitable conditions and restrained terracotta for unmet conditions. Refined regular Chinese serif/Kaiti typography with clear sizes and consistent alignment. Large map, compact information. No broad brush-stroke heading banners, no heavy gold ornament, no excessive torn paper, no huge crop illustration, no generic big three-column catalogue layout. This is a new clean map-and-diagnosis layout with a substrate workbench. Medium soft tones, crisp legible UI.

COMPOSITION:
1. Slim header about 7% of height. Title “灵圃” at left, smaller breadcrumb “玉虚仙宗 · 瑶圃峰”. Small “返回” button at right.
2. Upper main area about 65% of height, split about 61% map on the left and 39% clear diagnosis on the right. No permanent crop-catalogue sidebar.
3. Lower 25% of height is a full-width SUBSTRATE WORKBENCH, aligned and easy to scan horizontally. Keep good gutters and fine separators; don't put every line into a separate card.

LEFT MAP PANEL:
Compact toolbar at top: dropdown-like target selector exactly “目标灵植：月露苔”, then a group of understated tabs “生境” “温度” “水分” “灵力”, with “生境” active.
Below, an expansive true STRAIGHT-DOWN 90-DEGREE ORTHOGRAPHIC spirit-garden plan. ZERO isometric or oblique perspective. All rectangular bed edges parallel to the screen; no perspective trapezoids, no horizon, sky or distant mountains. Everything is seen from above, including a few tree canopies and flat stones. Draw natural DIFFERENT HABITATS on continuous ground, rather than nine identical cards: a shallow clear spring on one side, gray stone surfaces and moss beds near water, an area under the edge of tree canopy, warm brown soil patches and sunny herb beds joined by narrow earth paths. A few grounded rectangular beds of different widths fit into the terrain. Neat little plants seen from above, fine earth texture, understated ink-and-gouache flora.
A selected soil patch toward the left-center has a thin warm-ochre border, label “西侧圃地” and small state “停长”. Its soil is mostly ordinary brown soil with sparse weak pale-green moss patches; it is visibly NOT a fully suitable established wet rock bed. Elsewhere a shaded mossy rock patch beside the spring is subtly marked suitable, giving the map meaningful alternatives.
Only a few small habitat labels: “泉边”, “林阴”, “岩面”, “向阳畦”. Keep map readable and open. A small legend “适生” “需改善” may sit near the map edge. No large floating condition cards covering the terrain, no numbers on every plot, no player characters or corpses on the map.

RIGHT DIAGNOSIS PANEL:
Pale opaque ivory surface, fine dividers, no enormous botanical hero art. Heading exactly “环境对照”. Subheading “西侧圃地 · 月露苔” with a small restrained ochre status badge “停长”.
Show a beautifully aligned four-column comparison table, large readable characters, balanced column widths. Column headers exactly:
“条件” | “地块环境” | “灵草需求” | “判定”
Five rows exactly:
“温度” | “偏暖” | “凉润” | “偏离”
“灵力” | “偏低” | “充足” | “不足”
“水分” | “湿润” | “湿润” | “满足”
“光照” | “直射” | “遮阴” | “过强”
“基质” | “普通土层” | “阴湿岩面” | “缺少”
Use sage checkmark plus text for the satisfied water row, quiet terracotta text/mark for missing or mismatched conditions. Do not rely only on color. Subtly emphasize the substrate row without a huge red background.

Beneath the table, a compact reason area with clearly readable text exactly:
“主要原因：缺少岩面基质”
“持续不适将逐步受损”
A modest secondary action “查看培护”. All information should fit comfortably with padding, not be crammed into tiny type.

BOTTOM SUBSTRATE WORKBENCH:
A well-designed shallow full-width configuration area. Heading “基质配置” with small context “西侧圃地”.
Small material-category tabs “腐殖” “岩质” “遗骸”, with “岩质” selected. “遗骸” is an inactive future-category design provision, not a requirement of this moss; no graphic or biological remains need be pictured.
Below, read left to right using only a few quiet separated groups:
- “当前基底” with value “普通土层” and a small stylized soil-layer thumbnail.
- “待加入” with value “岩质基质” and a compact thumbnail of flat gray stone pieces, distinct from the existing base. This is a selected material in a configuration preview, no stack counts or price.
- “配置预览”, line “基质缺项可补足”, and smaller clear line “光照与灵力仍需处理”. This deliberately shows that adding substrate DOES NOT fix all growing problems.
- On the far right, a restrained sage action “预览配置” and secondary “清空选择”.
The workbench must remain shallower than the main map and comparison area, not become a gigantic inventory grid. No floating modal over the main table.

TEXT AND RULE CONSTRAINTS:
Use only the supplied Chinese copy where possible. No arbitrary temperatures, numerical spiritual-density values, costs, time estimates, percentages, crop yields or composite suitability scores. The qualitative conditions are a UI-design example, not game balance values, so no explanatory prototype label inside the product. No debug, testing, developer notes or lorem ipsum. No damage percentages or biological gore. No English UI text and no watermarks.

QUALITY CHECK:
The image must clearly communicate 1) heterogeneous plot environment, 2) a plant's required conditions, 3) each unmet reason, and 4) configurable substrate including a future remains category. The plant's main current blocker is missing wet rock substrate; adding the proposed rock substrate only addresses that blocker. Legible Chinese comparison table is essential. Orthographic map must be directly overhead, not a pretty countryside illustration. Premium usable game UI, balanced spacing, no thick repetitive brush banners or decorative empty panels.
edit_prompt:
Use case: text-localization / precise UI copy correction.
Edit the supplied UI image. Keep the full image, exact layout, 16:9 aspect ratio, colors, typography, all map details, all five rows in the environment comparison table, all headings, all buttons, and the substrate workbench unchanged.
Make ONLY this one text correction in the bottom "配置预览" section:
Replace the reddish line "光照与灵力仍需处理" with the exact Chinese text "温度、光照与灵力仍需处理".
The table also lists temperature as mismatched, so the preview must retain that issue. Fit the new sentence on a readable line in the same area using the same typeface, color and approximately the same size; there is sufficient horizontal room.
Do not change any other text or any interface layout. No new UI elements, no additional annotations, no watermark. Preserve the original wide 1672×941 composition.
